highlights.title: SpaceX Seeks to Raise $75 Billion in Record IPO
highlights.description: SpaceX is seeking to raise $75 billion in an initial public offering that would be the biggest of all time. Elon Musk’s rocket, satellite and artificial intelligence company plans to market about 555.6 million shares for $135 each, according to its filing Wednesday with the US Securities and Exchange Commission. Bloomberg's Manuel Baigorri reports. (Source: Bloomberg)

alsoIn.title: SpaceX expects its IPO to raise $74.4 billion

highlights.title: Apple's Overhauled Siri Will Reportedly Run on Nvidia's Blackwell Chips
highlights.description: Apple will rely on Google's fleet of Nvidia chips to power its overhauled version of Siri when it launches in September, according to a new report from The Information. Last week, the outlet reported that Apple plans to highlight the on-device AI capabilities of its devices at WWDC next week, but queries that require cloud-based processing will still fall back on one of Google's large Gemini models, as per an agreement between the two companies. highlights.description: Amazon engineers called out their employer for conducting mass layoffs while it commits to spending $200 billion this year on AI infrastructure.

highlights.title: OpenAI and Anthropic Sign Letter to Prevent AI-Developed Biological Weapons
highlights.description: Leading AI labs, executives, and scientists are sending a letter to lawmakers urging them to improve tracking of synthetic DNA sequences that could be used for bioweapons.

highlights.title: Broadcom AI Chip Outlook Disappoints Investors
highlights.description: Broadcom shares fell in extended trading after the company delivered a disappointing forecast for artificial intelligence chip revenue. Chief Executive Officer Hock Tan said the company $56 billion in AI chips in the fiscal year that ends in October. The forecast that fell short of the average estimate of $57.6 billion. Bloomberg's Neil Campling reports. (Source: Bloomberg)

highlights.title: Cerebras Says It’s Working With All AI Gear Makers Except Nvidia
highlights.description: Cerebras Systems Inc. plans to cooperate with a wide variety of suppliers of AI data center components, opening the way for further partnerships that mirror its agreement with Amazon.com Inc.

highlights.title: TSMC Warns Chip Supply Won’t Meet AI-Fueled Demand for Years
highlights.description: Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co.’s global chip supply will fall short of AI-fueled demand for years to come, chief executive officer C.C. Wei said, suggesting production capacity remains a key bottleneck in the buildout of global computing infrastructure.

ai.description: Thailand’s richest man, Sarath Ratanavadi, plans to spend as much as 140 billion baht ($4.3 billion) through Gulf Development Pcl over the next five years to expand data centers and other infrastructure needed to support the artificial intelligence boom.

ai.title: US Tech Sector Announces Most Job Cuts in Nearly Two Years
ai.description: US technology companies in May announced the most job cuts in nearly two years as they ramp up spending on artificial intelligence.

ai.title: AI Bubble 'Something to Look At,' BNP's Huynh Says
ai.description: Sophie Huynh, senior cross asset strategist at BNP Paribas Asset Management, discusses the risk of a so-called bubble in the artificial intelligence trade space. "What I'm looking at much more is tokens rationing," she tells Bloomberg Television. "There's anecdotes here and there that we're consuming so much tokens at this point that there's not going to be enough," Huynh says. She also discusses the impact of the ongoing conflict in the Middle East on markets. (Source: Bloomberg)
